description: This Java source file defines the RssService class, an Android Service that periodically fetches and updates RSS feed data, manages notifications, and handles requerying of feeds based on timing and external triggers.

classes.name: RssService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages periodic RSS feed updates, notifications, and requery logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notifications, content resolver, last checked time, and starts the background thread for updates.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles external commands to requery all feeds or a specific RSS URL.

methods.name: queryIfPeriodicRefreshRequired
methods.description: Checks if the scheduled refresh time has passed and triggers feed querying accordingly.

methods.name: queryRssItems
methods.description: Queries all RSS feeds, updates content if newer data is found, and resets the last checked time.

methods.name: queryItem
methods.description: Fetches and parses a single RSS feed URL, updates database if feed is newer.

methods.name: parseRssDocPubDate
methods.description: Extracts the pubDate from RSS XML and returns as GregorianCalendar.

methods.name: readRss
methods.description: Reads RSS feed content from a URL into a string.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Callback to requery feeds when scheduled.
